war.text: Araithia Shokta, known as Rat, guides the newly arrived Teyo around Ravnica, and with Kaya she helps rally the guilds against Bolas, starting with the Orzhov, whose triumvirate Bilagru convinces to join the fight.
Rat leads Kaya, Teyo and Nissa through secret routes to Selesnya, where her godfather Boruvo agrees to help introduce Kaya to the Selesnya leaders.
In Skarrg she finds Gan Shokta and Borborygmos fighting, urges them to unite the Clans, and wins the Gruul over by whispering to Borborygmos and kissing his cheek.
Later, Hekara is resurrected as a blood witch, but she walks right past Rat without noticing her, showing that her resurrection has left her unable to see Rat.
